resources.string: No paired computers yet. Run rconnect pair on the computer, then pair it here.
To connect again, you will have to pair the computer again.
Keep Bluetooth headphones awake during sessions
Stream audio from the computer only while something is playing.
Stream audio from the computer all the time.
Use drag and drop or accessibility actions to reorder. During a session, CapsLock+F10 switches between the checked modes in this order, and a session starts with the first checked mode.
At least one mode must stay checked.

Use drag and drop or accessibility actions to reorder. During a session, CapsLock+F9 switches between the checked modes in this order, and a session starts with the first checked mode. Use headphones, or the computer will hear what the phone plays.
The computer has a microphone, but it stays silent.
The phone\'s microphone is sent to the computer all the time.
Voice activity detection: the phone\'s microphone is sent only while someone speaks.
Allow removing the computer\'s microphone during a session

Once the computer has the microphone, CapsLock+F9 skips Off, so a call on the computer does not lose it and quietly switch to the computer\'s own microphone. Turn this on to let CapsLock+F9 remove it.
Without the microphone permission, the computer\'s microphone stays silent.
Microphone: %1$s, but RConnect has no microphone permission, so it stays silent.
The computer cannot offer a microphone.
Android has given the microphone to another app; the computer hears silence.
Turn computer audio down while speech plays
The computer cannot stream its audio.
The RConnect key capture service is off. Without it, keys the system uses for itself, such as Alt+Tab, do not reach the computer.
Run rconnect pair on the computer first. Then pick the computer below if it is on the same network, scan the QR code it shows with any QR code scanner app, or paste the pairing link.
Verification words: %1$s. Check that the computer shows the same words, then confirm there.
Connected to %1$s. Press CapsLock+F11 to end the session.
Ping: no answer from the computer, %1$s
This is how your computer will sound through RConnect.
Sends keys to the computer during an RConnect session, including shortcuts the system would otherwise handle. Outside a session it does nothing.
